title: The higher-chaos Krylov correction enlarges the fixed-Gaussian scalar-recentering and harmonic BRST instability window

recentering_and_brst.necessary_recentering: Uniform semiboundedness of H_N-a_N requires a_N<=6gC_N^2-kappa g sigma_N+O(N)
recentering_and_brst.explicit_window: For every fixed epsilon with 0<epsilon<c_star, if a_N>=6gC_N^2-g(kappa-epsilon)sigma_N eventually, then inf spec(H_N-a_N)<=-g epsilon sigma_N+O(N)->-infinity
recentering_and_brst.weak_limit: The normalized fixed trial has vacuum coefficient 1/sqrt(2+t^2), while X_N and Y_N are orthogonal to the vacuum. Every weakly convergent subsequence therefore has a nonzero vacuum component
recentering_and_brst.mosco_failure: Weak compactness supplies such a subsequence, whose recentered form values tend to minus infinity; fixed-Gaussian Mosco weak liminf fails throughout the stated window for every finite semibounded limiting form
recentering_and_brst.brst_transfer: Tensor the trial with K1471's normalized degree-zero harmonic BRST vacuum. The tensor-sum form keeps the same matter value and nonzero harmonic vacuum component, so the full and harmonic-compressed forms inherit the spectral and Mosco failure
recentering_and_brst.ceiling: The result excludes only the explicit fixed-Gaussian scalar window. It does not determine E_N, exclude E_N+O(1) recentering, produce compactness, or bind singular dressings, non-Gaussian measures and changed representations
